name: merav-cart-builder
description: Safely turn prepared MERAVHOME Studio Spec Book runs into retailer carts and draft-only rep emails.

interface.shortDescription: Build carts and draft rep emails
interface.longDescription: Retrieves one secure, short-lived Studio procurement run, creates Studio-frozen rep-email drafts through a tool with no Send operation, guides exact product and option matching with @Chrome, and reports each result back to Studio without authorizing checkout.
defaultPrompt: Use Merav Cart Builder to create draft-only rep emails and use @Chrome to process my prepared Studio cart run.
